items.name: image/blog-post
items.title: Blog Post Template
items.description: An open graph card for an article, with a category pill, an oversized title, and an author byline.

items.name: image/changelog
items.title: Changelog Template
items.description: An open graph card for a release, with the version, the date, and a summary of what shipped.

items.name: image/docs
items.title: Docs Template
items.description: An open graph card for a documentation page, tinted by a colour you pass and headed by the site's icon.

items.name: image/event
items.title: Event Template
items.description: An open graph card for a talk or a conference, with the title above a when, where, and host footer.

items.name: image/product-card
items.title: Product Card Template
items.description: An open graph card for a product, with its image, name, price, and a line of copy.

items.name: image/quote
items.title: Quote Template
items.description: A high-contrast open graph card for a quote, attributed to a person and a company.

items.name: image/repository
items.title: Repository Template
items.description: An open graph card for a repository, with its slug, description, and star, fork, and language counts.

items.name: image/og-route
items.title: Open Graph Route
items.description: A Next.js route that answers /og with a rendered card. Reads the title from the query string and falls back to a default.
